source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: This model's attacks against **CHARACTER** units may re-roll both the **Hit roll** and the **Wound roll**. You gain 1CP for every enemy **CHARACTER** unit **destroyed** by this model.
